theorems.name: Submission.bf_haar_null_to_frames
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun v : Fin n → Rn N ↦ frameProjection v) {v | LinearIndependent ℝ v} → ∀ θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1) → (∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ W₀ : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ W₀ = n → ∀ Q : Set (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), MeasurableSet Q → θ {g | g * W₀.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g ∈ Q} = 0 → ForAlmostAllProjections N n (fun p ↦ p ∉ Q)
